activity.role: Governor-General of the Dutch East Indies
activity.notes: Coen's governor-generalship was an executive office of the VOC's Asian territorial system. ATLAS represents the VOC as the political-corporate authority requested by the user and stores his two non-continuous terms separately.

sources.title: Jan Pieterszoon Coen — biographical office chronology
sources.citation_text: The office chronology records Coen's two terms as Governor-General of the Dutch East Indies: 30 April 1618–1 February 1623 and 30 September 1627–21 September 1629.
